department: MCQST Doctoral Fellowships in Quantum Science & Technology (formerly IMPRS-QST)

deadline.value: Apply by January 11, 2027 (call opens October 15, 2026); reference letters are due January 15, 2027.

supervisor.value: Admission is by committee; you only list non-binding supervisor preferences and are matched to a group after selection.
supervisor.quote: Your choice of research groups or potential supervisors is not binding.

also.quote: Selected students will be matched with suitable PhD projects and research groups

funding.value: Doctoral fellowships; terms not stated on the pages checked.

entry_route.value: You need a Master's degree or equivalent before starting; applicants who did their Master's or thesis in Munich are not eligible.
entry_route.quote: You hold, or expect to complete, a Master's degree or equivalent qualification before you start your PhD.

also.quote: the fellowships are open only to external applicants who did not complete their Master’s studies or Master’s thesis in Munich.

notes: One shared platform: apply for the MCQST fellowship, the Munich Quantum Valley (MQV) fellowship, or both. IMPRS-QST no longer runs a separate program.
